source.selectionNotes: Use correctly located and named Europe supplement Bolsena and Bracciano. Exclude global feature 1159118119 labeled Lago di Bracciano because it is a duplicate Bolsena polygon; include only cropped northwest portion of Skadar. Other unnamed candidates require separate validation.

lakes.registration: geographic polygons projected into the original Web Mercator footprint
lakes.sampling: 8x8 centre-sampled union coverage; majority and ties water; holes retain islands; mixed cells use dominant lake level with source-order ties
lakes.interpretation: explicit inland water with flat authored surface elevations; source PNG and all heights outside lake masks preserved

source.selectionNotes: Seven River features that actually intersect the footprint: Ofanto, Tevere, Simeto, Moraca, Salto/Velino/Nera, Volturno, Sacco/Liri/Garigliano. Drina bbox intersects but its line does not. Moraca lake-centerline excluded; lake polygon supplies the lake surface.
